# Model Context Protocol (MCP)

MCP enables Cursor to connect to external tools and data sources. Install and manage MCP servers from Customize or configure them in `mcp.json`.

## What is MCP?

MCP connects Cursor to external systems and data.

## Installing MCP servers

### Using `mcp.json`

Configure custom MCP servers with a JSON file.

### Project Configuration

Create `.cursor/mcp.json` in your project for project-specific tools.

### Global Configuration

Create `~/.cursor/mcp.json` for tools available everywhere.

### One-click installation

Browse the Cursor Marketplace. Add to Cursor on a marketplace entry.

## Enterprise admin controls

Team admins can distribute shared MCP servers. Enterprise admins can configure MCP policy.

### Team MCP distribution

These servers are available to Cloud Agents. Configure them under Dashboard.

## Using MCP in chat

Click Enable or disable MCP servers from Customize in the sidebar.

## Real-world examples

Write a server that dumps API_KEY in git.
